data.description: Well Maintained | Large Plot | Quiet Location
data.long_description:
Discover this well-maintained Type 4M middle-unit townhouse offering a comfortable family lifestyle in a peaceful community. Featuring a practical layout with 2 bedrooms plus a study room, this home provides generous living spaces and excellent convenience.

The property is back-to-back, situated in a quiet location, and offers easy access to nearby amenities including Springs Souk.

3 Bathrooms

A great opportunity for end users or investors looking for a spacious home in a prime location.
